name: Lemon Posset
description: Three ingredients and almost no effort. Lemon juice sets hot cream into a silky, tangy pudding.
keywords: protein:Vegetarian, carb:None / Other, make-ahead, dinner party
recipeIngredient: 2 lemons, zested and juiced (about 75 ml juice)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the cream and sugar in a pan, stirring until the sugar dissolves, then boil for exactly 3 minutes.
Take off the heat, stir in the lemon juice and most of the zest and leave to cool for 10 minutes.
Strain into small glasses or pots and chill for at least 3 hours until set. Top with the remaining zest.
